Hi Priya — thanks again for a productive discovery earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the 30-minute product intro for your team: 

Recap (2 min):
- Primary goals: validate integration surface for inference (embeddings + reranking) and understand throughput SLAs for peak batch jobs.
- Success criteria for the intro: show a short live walkthrough of the Redwood API (chat + embeddings), confirm infra/connectivity questions, and identify necessary stakeholders for a pilot.

Proposed 30-minute intro windows (all PT):
1) Tue, Dec 1 — 9:00–9:30 AM PT (exec sponsor + engineering lead)
2) Wed, Dec 2 — 11:00–11:30 AM PT (ops/infra + product manager)

Could you let me know which of those works best and who from NovaForge will attend (we typically include an engineering owner and a product/ops sponsor)? If neither slot fits, tell me two alternatives and we’ll re-propose.

I’ve attached a one-page MutualActionPlan (MAP) and a brief infra snapshot you mentioned — both are light prep for the call. Links to the HubSpot record and a tentative calendar draft are below.

Attachments:
- MutualActionPlan_v1.pdf (attachment)
- novaforge-infra-snapshot.png (attachment)

Thanks — we can tailor the walkthrough based on who joins.
